run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the largest sum contiguous subarray in a list of integers
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correct maximum subarray sum results
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the TOFILL placeholder with an equivalent implementation
review_f_gold: review f_gold which implements Kadane's algorithm for maximum contiguous subarray sum
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that computes the maximum sum of a contiguous subarray using O(n) time
